geo_provisional.description: All boundary/key-area geometry derived from repository PROV-* provisional boundaries (sourced to official announcement 2026-05-09 / SRC-2026-BJ-GH-QUAL-PREANNOUNCEMENT). The three key-area ANNOUNCED areas (Zhongzhiyuan 192.1 ha, AI Origin Community 104.3 ha, Dazhongsi 72.0 ha; total 368.4 ha) are taken verbatim from the official announcement; our polygons are agent_inferred_from_public_data, low-confidence provisional_rough approximations, NOT official redlines. Precision-sensitive areas recomputed on official geometry arrival.

area_recalculation.description: All precision-sensitive area metrics recomputed from official polygons on arrival.

far_assumed.description: FAR 1.0 is a DESIGN-SCENARIO ASSUMPTION (planning reference value), not an approved control indicator and not a verified planning metric. It is used only to illustrate development intensity at a walkable-block scale. Under this scenario, implied total floor area ≈43,609,232 m² (site_area × FAR 1.0) — scenario illustration only. Accordingly both floor_area_ratio and total_floor_area are declared status=unknown with value=null in metrics.json. Replace with the approved FAR and recompute all derived floor-area figures once the official regulatory plan is published.

official_data_gap.description: Official detailed planning conditions not in cleared public package; gaps do not block content scoring.

urban_fragmentation_hypothesis.description: Design hypothesis pending on-site verification: the living / R&D / showcase segments of AI talent and industry are spatially severed by the railway and expressways. No reviewed public source for current traffic, walkability, industry or public-service baselines was available in the cleared package; the open-call task book cannot serve as evidence of existing site conditions. Treated explicitly as a design hypothesis, not an established site fact, until an on-site survey or reviewed baseline source is obtained.
urban_fragmentation_hypothesis.recalculation_trigger: On-site survey or reviewed baseline data on traffic / walkability / industry

baseline_traffic_walkability.description: Baseline gap: no reviewed traffic counts, road capacity, signal timing, transit supply, pavement network, crossing facilities, or barrier断点 data. The three road centre-lines in roads.geojson are agent-inferred schematic geometry (confidence=medium) and are not a basis for traffic or walkability calculation. Railway/expressway severance is carried as a design hypothesis only.
baseline_traffic_walkability.verification_path: Replace the schematic network with official or surveyed road and pedestrian network data; compute link capacity and level of service from classified counts and signal cycles, and compute 500m/800m pedestrian catchment coverage from a walkable topology with recorded barriers.
baseline_traffic_walkability.recalculation_trigger: Official or surveyed traffic / pedestrian network data becomes available

baseline_industry_service.description: Baseline gap: no reviewed inventory of industrial floor area, occupancy, rents, tenant mix, or public-service facility capacity. Industry-related statements in the proposal are concept judgements from public material and are not a basis for investment, output, or employment estimates.
baseline_industry_service.verification_path: Build a stock inventory from parcel and building records; compute carrying capacity from leasable area and facility capacity; overlay with public-service facility service radii for cross-check.
baseline_industry_service.recalculation_trigger: Industrial space census or building inventory obtained

baseline_land_ownership.description: Baseline gap: no parcel ownership, floor area or use records, building safety appraisal, heritage value assessment, underground conditions, or utility survey. Retain/renovate/demolish statements are concept suggestions only and must not be read as ownership or demolition conclusions.
baseline_land_ownership.verification_path: Verify ownership and use parcel by parcel; commission building safety and heritage appraisals; complete underground and utility detection; then revise retain/renovate/demolish and phasing accordingly.
baseline_land_ownership.recalculation_trigger: Parcel survey, building appraisal, or underground detection initiated

baseline_municipal_capacity.description: Baseline gap: no data on existing utility network diameters, residual capacity, water and power source conditions, nor the floor-area and population base required by the applicable municipal planning standards. No load calculation is performed in this package.
baseline_municipal_capacity.verification_path: From the approved floor area and population base, compute water, drainage, power, telecom and gas loads under the current municipal planning standards; compare against residual network capacity; identify upgrading works where shortfalls appear.
baseline_municipal_capacity.recalculation_trigger: Municipal network inventory and capacity data obtained, or phased intensity fixed

baseline_cost_estimate.description: Baseline gap and explicit red line: per README L233, investment estimates must not be presented as established conclusions. No unit rates, quantities, funding sources, or commitments exist in this package; phasing and cost content is a conceptual implementation framework only and is not a budget or investment basis.
baseline_cost_estimate.verification_path: Apply current Beijing construction cost indices and comparable urban-regeneration settlement data as unit-rate basis; estimate by phase across building, municipal, landscape and relocation quantities; state funding sources and responsible entities explicitly.
baseline_cost_estimate.recalculation_trigger: Budget preparation, investment decision, or financing arrangement initiated
baseline_cost_estimate.owner: participant (estimation) / cost consultant and funding entities (basis)
